name: Mankrik
summary: Mankrik is a grief-stricken orc warrior stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. After a vicious quilboar ambush separated him from his wife, Olgra, he has dedicated his life to avenging her and cutting down every bristled beast he can find.

sections.title: Ambush in the Dust
sections.body: While traveling through the scrublands of the Barrens, Mankrik and his wife Olgra were overrun by swarms of quilboar during a skirmish at a small tauren settlement. Separated in the chaos and frantic fighting, Mankrik watched Olgra disappear under a tide of tusks and thorn-woven weapons. Overwhelmed by fury, he fought recklessly until he was struck down unconscious. He survived only because a passing tauren druid discovered him bleeding out along the Gold Road and bound his injuries.

sections.title: Consumed by Vengeance
sections.body: Recovering at the Crossroads, Mankrik found himself paralyzed by grief and an all-consuming bloodlust. Though local leaders like Thork warn that his blind hatred clouds his judgment and refuse to mount official war parties, Mankrik refuses to move on. Haunted by uncertainty over Olgra's fate, he enlists any willing Horde travelers to scour the Barrens for sign of his lost mate and to slaughter any quilboar that cross their path.

faq.answer: Mankrik is an orc warrior residing at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He survived a brutal quilboar ambush that separated him from his wife, leaving him consumed by rage and bent on avenging her.
During a clash at a tauren settlement, Mankrik and Olgra were cut off from each other by overwhelming numbers of quilboar. Mankrik was beaten down in the chaos, and Olgra was lost amid the fighting.

faq.q: How did Mankrik survive the battle?
faq.answer: After falling unconscious under swarms of quilboar, Mankrik was found collapsed on the Gold Road by a wandering tauren druid, who tended to his grievous wounds and brought him to safety.

faq.q: Why does Thork refuse to help Mankrik?
faq.answer: Thork, the leader at the Crossroads, believes that Mankrik's intense rage and thirst for vengeance have completely clouded his judgment, preventing him from acting rationally.

angles.text: Mankrik embodies the devastating cost of settling the wild frontiers of Kalimdor, where family and honor are tested constantly against brutal indigenous threats.
For travelers arriving at the Crossroads, Mankrik's plight serves as a stark introduction to the unrelenting threat posed by the bristled quilboar packs across the Barrens.
